positions.summary_short: Charles Cooper campaigns on better roads, stewardship, governance and accountability.
summary_bullets: Campaign pillars: Better Roads, Better Stewardship, Better Governance, Better Accountability.
Business owner, resident, volunteer and community organizer in Lake of Bays.
Town bio stresses less government, operational efficiencies and fiscal restraint.
positions.verbatim_quote: Innovating Lake of Bays. Better Roads. Better Stewardship. Better Governance. Better Accountability.
positions.source_title: Home - Charles Cooper - Regional Councillor (campaign site)

positions.summary_short: Charles Cooper promises fiscal restraint and operational efficiency from a less-government approach.
summary_bullets: Views a smaller-government approach as enhancing township operational efficiencies and ensuring fiscal restraint.
Provided strong leadership to organizations maximizing services to vulnerable populations with minimal budget change year to year.
Chaired finance and audit committee (One Kids Place) and was Chairman of the Board of Peel Senior Link.
positions.verbatim_quote: His background in technology and business, combined with his view of less government will enhance operational efficiencies of the township, ensuring fiscal restraint.
positions.source_title: Mayor candidate biography - Township of Lake of Bays official election page

positions.summary_short: Tim Withey leans on two terms on Huntsville Council and deep board experience for fiscally and environmentally responsible leadership.
summary_bullets: Two-term Huntsville councillor including Chair of Community Services and Corporate Services; served on District Council's Health Services Committee.
Education, business experience and extensive community service as a foundation for responsible fiscal, environmental, infrastructure and healthcare decision-making.
Extensive board service: hospitals, nursing home, hospice, chamber, Crimestoppers, OPP board, forestry authority.
positions.verbatim_quote: His education, business experience and extensive community service provide a strong foundation for responsible fiscal, environmental, infrastructure and healthcare decision-making.
positions.source_title: Mayor candidate biography - Township of Lake of Bays official election page

positions.summary_short: Matt Young promises fiscal responsibility, community engagement and strong representation for Lake of Bays.
summary_bullets: Fiscal Responsibility: leading with a transparent, accountable approach to how the Township invests every tax dollar.
Community Engagement: strengthening the relationship between Council and residents so every voice helps shape the future.
Strong Representation: ensuring Lake of Bays' priorities are heard at District and provincial levels.
positions.verbatim_quote: Fiscal Responsibility - Leading with a transparent, accountable approach to how the Township invests every tax dollar.
positions.source_title: Matt Young For Lake of Bays Mayor - campaign website

positions.summary_short: Matt Young wants year-round economic growth, local jobs, affordability and responsible development.
summary_bullets: Economic Growth: building on local strengths for a stronger, more diverse year-round economy.
Business and Employment: keeping business and employment in the region so local growth benefits residents.
Affordability: addressing rising costs of living and housing with a forward-looking economic strategy.
Responsible Development: balancing economic growth with protecting the history and environment that define Lake of Bays.
positions.verbatim_quote: Economic Growth - Building on local strengths to create a stronger, more diverse economy that supports our area year-round.
positions.source_title: Matt Young For Lake of Bays Mayor - campaign website

positions.summary_short: Matt Young wants responsible development with guardrails to protect Lake of Bays' environment and character.
summary_bullets: Responsible Development: Council must weigh not only what growth brings but how it affects residents, businesses, infrastructure and the environment.
Guards: growth should come with the right guardrails to protect lakes, shorelines, parks, natural environment and community character.
Community Care: supporting residents at every stage of life so they can live, grow and age in Lake of Bays.
positions.verbatim_quote: Matt believes Council must consider not only what growth can bring, but how that growth will affect local residents, businesses, infrastructure, and the environment.
positions.source_title: Matt Young For Lake of Bays Mayor - campaign website

positions.summary_short: John Crowley promises common-sense, community-first representation with fiscal responsibility.
summary_bullets: Advocates for the community with common sense, a proactive approach, community first, fiscal responsibility and local perspective.
Believes in promoting community first in what the township does and how it talks.
Background: paramedic, teacher, air ambulance medical logistics coordinator; ran a family farm.
positions.verbatim_quote: I believe we all have a responsibility to our communities. I am fully prepared to make that commitment, advocating for our community with common sense, proactive approach, community first, fiscal responsibility and local perspective.
positions.source_title: District Councillor (Franklin/Sinclair Ward) biography - Township of Lake of Bays official election page

positions.summary_short: Rick Brooks pledges balanced development, firefighter support and active resident dialogue.
summary_bullets: Pledges a balanced approach to development between community growth needs and environment/climate concerns.
Promises to keep fighting for firefighters' needs so they have the tools to protect residents and communities.
Emphasizes being approachable and maintaining dialogue with residents, lake associations and advisory committees.
positions.verbatim_quote: Continuing to encourage a balanced approach to development between the need to grow our communities and the concerns of the environment and the adverse effects of climate change.
positions.source_title: District Councillor (Franklin/Sinclair Ward) biography - Township of Lake of Bays official election page

positions.summary_short: Linda Boothby offers municipal-government experience and a practical, informed voice for Franklin Ward.
summary_bullets: Ten years in municipal government (tax collector) gives her understanding of taxation, zoning bylaws and council procedures.
Committed to listening, working together and protecting what makes Lake of Bays special for future generations.
Local business founder (garden centre) and Dwight Farmers' Market organizer with about 65 vendors.
positions.verbatim_quote: She is committed to listening, working together and protecting what makes Lake of Bays special for future generations.
positions.source_title: Councillor (Franklin Ward) biography - Township of Lake of Bays official election page

positions.summary_short: Mike Jefford wants shoreline protection, government efficiency and year-round community support.
summary_bullets: Platform themes: supporting entrepreneurs, shoreline protection, government efficiency, respecting rights and agency, year-round communities.
Wants to protect lake health and support responsible development.
Would continue the previous administration's commitment to shoreline buffers and the natural beauty of the township and lakes.
positions.verbatim_quote: Supporting entrepreneurs, shoreline protection, government efficiency, respecting rights/agency and developing year-round communities.
positions.source_title: Mike Jefford for Ridout Ward - campaign website

positions.summary_short: Mike Jefford wants to help local entrepreneurs stay open year-round and keep regulations targeted.
summary_bullets: Recognized the need to help Dorset and Baysville entrepreneurs stay open in shoulder and winter seasons despite slower sales.
Wants residents to have meaningful work opportunities in the communities.
Government must respect personal agency and property rights; regulations should be laser-focused on real problems, not large blanket by-laws.
positions.verbatim_quote: Many entrepreneurs in Dorset and Baysville give a big effort to remain open over the shoulder and winter seasons despite slower sales. I recognized a need and opportunity to help them.
positions.source_title: Councillor (Ridout Ward) biography - Township of Lake of Bays official election page

positions.summary_short: Michael Mahovlich prioritizes protecting natural shorelines and clean water while growing density in towns.
summary_bullets: Says Lake of Bays is one of the last areas with natural shorelines and clean waters and must be protected.
Wants a hard look at loophole practices like nuisance mosquito spraying for unintended environmental and economic consequences.
Supports dark skies revisions pending public opinion and staff reporting.
Favors density in towns, not at the water's edge, to preserve the lakes.
positions.verbatim_quote: Balancing economic development while maintaining natural shorelines is a top priority.
positions.source_title: Michael Mahovlich for McLean Ward Councillor - campaign website

positions.summary_short: Michael Mahovlich wants more housing density in towns and a Lake of Bays cycling path.
summary_bullets: Says Muskoka needs more housing options; community input is critical to achieve greater density in towns, not at the water's edge.
As a small business owner wants innovative, community-driven solutions to business red tape.
Calls a separated path around Lake of Bays a way to draw the community together and boost tourism, working with the District and MTO.
positions.verbatim_quote: We are in need of more housing options in Muskoka. Community input is critical to ensure that we achieve greater density in towns, but not at the water's edge.
positions.source_title: Michael Mahovlich for McLean Ward Councillor - campaign website

positions.summary_short: Michael Mahovlich wants safe separated bike paths around Lake of Bays.
summary_bullets: Says Muskoka lacks safe separated bike paths and could draw many more cycling enthusiasts.
Would work with the district and MTO on a path around Lake of Bays as a tourism draw, similar to Uxbridge.
As a cycling enthusiast supports growing pedestrian and cycling paths.
positions.verbatim_quote: A path around Lake of Bays would draw our community together in a new way and be a fabulous tourism draw, similar to other cycling hubs like Uxbridge.
positions.source_title: Michael Mahovlich for McLean Ward Councillor - campaign website

positions.summary_short: Donald Blais prioritizes child well-being, safe schools, belonging and graduation rates.
summary_bullets: Top concern is the well-being of children: a safe school, tools and training for staff, and a sense of belonging for families regardless of background, beliefs or orientation.
Supports the Committee for Children in Difficulty with the necessary budget.
Wants high graduation rates by helping children reach their full potential.
positions.verbatim_quote: Provide all the necessary tools and training to staff members to maintain a safe environment in our schools.
positions.source_title: Vote Donald Blais: School Trustee - votedonaldblais.ca

positions.summary_short: Donald Blais promises transparency and leans on 12 years as trustee and relationships with officials.
summary_bullets: Wants transparency: minimize closed-door discussions and maximize public debates.
Cites 12 years as a school trustee and good relations with provincial politicians, the Director of Education, superintendents and staff.
Supports traditional professions promotion to address AI labour-market changes and environmental education.
positions.verbatim_quote: Minimize closed-door discussions and maximize public debates.
positions.source_title: Vote Donald Blais: School Trustee - votedonaldblais.ca
